title.narrative: Strengthening Media Persons¿ Capacity and Engagement for Human Rights and Fundamental Freedoms

description.narrative:
Overall Objective (OO):

To contribute to democratic consolidation and protection of human rights and fundamental freedoms through capacity building and engagement of media persons (i.e., journalists, bloggers, vloggers, podcasters) and civil society with relevant state institutions and corporate entities, and through media literacy among youth.

Specific objectives (SO):

SO1: To build capacity of a cohort of media persons (i.e., journalists, bloggers, vloggers & podcasters) to report on human rights, fundamental freedoms and democratic process safely, accurately, independently and in an inclusive manner.

SO2: To enable advocacy/ engagement of media persons (i.e., journalists, bloggers, vloggers, podcasters) and civil society organizations (CSOs) with policy makers, media regulators and social media platforms (e.g., TikTok) to create conducive policy environment and fair regulation of new technologies for independent, accurate, inclusive and safe media reporting on human rights, fundamental freedoms and democratic process.

SO3: To promote media literacy and counter digital threats to democracy and human rights (e.g., disinformation) through youth engagement and public awareness campaigns with focus on those with social influence and outreach capacity.

title.narrative: Country score on the Economist Intelligence Units Democracy Index

description.narrative: The Democracy Index is based on five categories: electoral process and pluralism; civil liberties; the functioning of government; political participation; and political culture. It provides a snapshot of the state of democracy for 165 independent states, which make up the majority of the worlds states (microstates are excluded). There is both an overall score as well as scores in individual categories. Based on their scores on a range of indicators within these categories, each country is then itself categorised as one of four types of regime: full democracies; flawed democracies; hybrid regimes; and authoritarian regimes.
